A car starts braking as it approaches a road junction. After braking for t seconds, the car has traveled a distance of s(t) meters, where s(t) = -t^2 + 20t . How far does the car travel from the time the brakes are applied until it stops?

A. -20 m
B. 10 m
C. 50 m
D. 100 m
